clue.text: Water supply (bottled) showing little sign of ageing

clue.text: eg registered undertakings, which could be shocking

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to stay or accommodate; as a noun it is the porter's cottage at an estate entrance.

clue.text: Here's a sticky substance, so rinse correctly

taken as written

clue.text: Enjoy oneself playing a hot video game

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: On top of too much fibbing?

parts.note: over means excessively, as in over-eager

parts.note: over means above
a ruler is a leader

clue.text: Object under canvas keeps one working

clue.text: Unfold the plots at Chelsea each year?
